Bigg Boss 20 House Design and Potential Contestant Revealed

The upcoming season of the reality television show Bigg Boss 20 is set to feature a house with a "duality" theme, incorporating elements of contrast. The house design includes a shark-themed pool, a "Vardaan" theme, a giant dramatic statue at the entrance, a teapot-shaped couch, and a chessboard with octopus tentacles. Two mysterious rooms, Room No. 20 and Room 2X, are highlighted as points of suspense. Reports also suggest that Indian YouTuber Nitish Rajput, who has reportedly been banned in Pakistan, may be a contestant on the show.
